svg.aria-label: SentinelOps AI: An incident commander built from seven agents. They read the logs, reason to a root cause, size the blast radius, then stop for human sign-off before writing the post-mortem. Built with TypeScript, Gemini SDK, JSON schemas, Cloud Run.
